component.name: Moto Buds
component.summary: Control and companion utility for Motorola Moto Buds on Linux

description.p: Moto Buds is a desktop application and command-line companion for Motorola Moto Buds earbuds on Linux. It provides direct control over Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), battery levels, low-latency Game Mode, spatial audio, and hardware preferences over Bluetooth RFCOMM.
